preconditions.description: The number of files n must be between 1 and 500.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(name) <= 8 and name.islower() for name in file_names)
preconditions.description: Each file name must be a string of 1 to 8 lowercase letters.
The number of distinct file names must equal n.

preconditions.expression: all(len(dependencies) <= n for dependencies in all_dependencies)
preconditions.description: Each file's dependencies must not exceed the total number of files.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'SHIP IT' if not has_cycle else any(len(cycle) == min_cycle_length for cycle in cycles)
postconditions.description: If there are no cycles, output 'SHIP IT'; otherwise, output a shortest cycle.

postconditions.expression: all(cycle[i] in dependencies[cycle[i+1]] for i in range(len(cycle)-1)) and cycle[-1] in dependencies[cycle[0]]
postconditions.description: The output cycle must represent valid dependencies in the correct order.
